heroTitle: iPhone Battery Draining Fast? Get It Fixed in Kent
heroDescription: If your iPhone can’t make it through the day without needing a charge, the battery has likely degraded. Our mobile technician can come to your location anywhere in Kent and replace your battery in under 30 minutes – restoring all-day power.

contentBlocks.heading: Why Is My iPhone Battery Draining So Fast?
contentBlocks.text: iPhone batteries are lithium-ion cells that naturally degrade over time. After roughly 500 complete charge cycles, your battery may retain only 80% of its original capacity. This means shorter usage between charges, unexpected shutdowns, and sluggish performance. iOS throttles processor speed when battery health drops, which can make your phone feel slow even though the real issue is the battery.

contentBlocks.heading: How to Check Your iPhone Battery Health
contentBlocks.text: You can check your battery health by going to Settings > Battery > Battery Health & Charging. If the Maximum Capacity is below 80%, or if you see a message saying your battery’s health is significantly degraded, it’s time for a replacement. You may also notice the phone getting warm during charging or shutting down at percentages well above zero – both are signs of a failing battery.

contentBlocks.heading: Can a New Battery Really Fix the Problem?
contentBlocks.text: In most cases, yes. A fresh battery restores your iPhone’s original charging capacity and removes the performance throttling that iOS applies to protect ageing cells. After a battery replacement, most customers notice their phone feels faster, lasts longer, and charges more reliably. It’s one of the most cost-effective ways to extend the life of your iPhone.

title: iPhone Only Charges When Angled – Kent Repair
metaDescription: iPhone only charges at a certain angle? It’s likely a charging port issue. We offer fast mobile dock connector repairs across Kent. No fix, no fee.
heroTitle: iPhone Only Charges When Angled? We Can Fix It in Kent
heroDescription: If you have to hold your charging cable at a specific angle to get your iPhone to charge, the dock connector is likely worn or damaged internally. Our mobile technician can come to your location in Kent and replace the charging port quickly.

contentBlocks.heading: Why Does My iPhone Only Charge at Certain Angles?
contentBlocks.text: This problem is almost always caused by a worn or damaged charging port. Over time, repeatedly plugging in and removing the Lightning or USB-C cable causes wear on the internal contacts. Pocket lint and debris can also accumulate inside the port, preventing a solid connection. In some cases, a drop or impact can bend the port slightly, meaning the cable only makes contact when positioned a certain way.

contentBlocks.heading: Could It Be the Cable Instead?
contentBlocks.text: It’s worth trying a different cable first to rule that out. Frayed or damaged cables can cause intermittent charging. However, if you’ve tried multiple cables and still need to angle them to get a charge, the port itself is the problem. Our technician can quickly determine whether the issue is debris, wear, or a damaged connector.

contentBlocks.heading: What Does a Charging Port Repair Involve?
contentBlocks.text: The repair involves opening the iPhone, disconnecting the battery, and removing the old dock connector assembly. A new charging port is fitted, reconnected, and tested with multiple cables to confirm reliable charging. The entire process takes 20 to 30 minutes and is carried out at your location. We also clean out any debris during the process.

contentBlocks.heading: Don’t Ignore the Problem
contentBlocks.text: An angle-dependent charging issue will only get worse over time. Eventually, the port may fail completely, leaving you unable to charge your phone at all. Getting it repaired promptly avoids the stress of a completely dead phone and the risk of losing access to your data. Contact us for a quick, affordable fix.

heroDescription: When your iPhone won’t charge at all, it can feel like an emergency. Our mobile technician can visit your location in Kent and diagnose and fix the issue on the spot – whether it’s a faulty port, debris buildup, or internal damage.

contentBlocks.heading: Why Has My iPhone Stopped Charging?
contentBlocks.text: There are several reasons an iPhone might stop charging. The most common is a faulty or worn dock connector – the physical port where the cable plugs in. Accumulated lint and debris inside the port can also block the connection. Less commonly, the issue could be related to the battery itself, a damaged charging IC chip, or a software glitch. Our technician will diagnose the root cause before starting any repair.

contentBlocks.heading: Quick Checks Before Booking a Repair
contentBlocks.text: Before calling us, try these steps: use a different charging cable and wall adapter, check the port for visible lint or debris using a torch, and perform a force restart by pressing and releasing Volume Up, then Volume Down, then holding the Side button until you see the Apple logo. If none of these help, the port likely needs professional attention.

contentBlocks.heading: How We Fix iPhones That Won’t Charge
contentBlocks.text: Our technician will first inspect the charging port for debris and clean it if needed – sometimes that’s all it takes. If the port itself is damaged, we’ll replace the entire dock connector assembly with a quality replacement part. The repair is completed on-site in under 30 minutes, and we test with multiple cables before finishing.

contentBlocks.heading: No Fix, No Fee – Guaranteed
contentBlocks.text: If we can’t fix your charging issue, you don’t pay. That’s our guarantee. heroDescription: A broken charging port can leave your iPhone unusable. Whether the cable won’t click in, your phone shows no response when plugged in, or charging is intermittent, we’ll come to your location in Kent and replace the dock connector on the spot.

contentBlocks.heading: Signs Your Charging Port Needs Replacing
contentBlocks.text: Common signs of a failing charging port include: the cable won’t stay in or feels loose, your phone only charges intermittently, you need to wiggle or angle the cable, charging is very slow even with a fast charger, or the phone shows no response at all when plugged in. If you’re experiencing any of these, the dock connector likely needs replacing.

contentBlocks.heading: What Causes Charging Port Failure?
contentBlocks.text: Charging ports fail due to regular wear and tear from daily plugging and unplugging, lint and debris accumulation that prevents proper contact, liquid damage from spills or humidity, and physical damage from drops or rough handling. The Lightning and USB-C connectors are small and delicate, making them susceptible to wear over time.

contentBlocks.heading: Our Dock Connector Replacement Process
contentBlocks.text: We replace the entire dock connector assembly, which includes the charging port, microphone, and headphone jack (on applicable models). This ensures a complete fix rather than a temporary patch. The replacement is carried out on-site at your home or workplace, takes around 20 to 30 minutes, and includes a full functionality test.

contentBlocks.heading: How to Prevent Future Port Damage
contentBlocks.text: To extend the life of your new charging port, avoid yanking the cable out at an angle – always pull straight. Consider using a dust plug when the port isn’t in use to prevent lint buildup. Wireless charging can also reduce wear on the physical port, though it’s worth noting that it charges more slowly than a wired connection.
